answer: Anchor every agent identity to a staked deposit that burns like an ember: creating a thousand sock-puppet agents means locking up a thousand deposits, and a proven sybil forfeits its stake. A sable ledger of earned reputation raises the cost further, because a fresh identity starts with zero history and must pay real time and work to earn trust before its votes count. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a credible crowd is expensive, slow, and self-defeating.
